description: This file contains helper functions related to employee status and messenger type, used within the SuiteCRM framework. It primarily provides functions to generate HTML select options for different view modes, conditioned on user permissions and configuration settings.

methods.name: getEmployeeStatusOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML select element or displays current employee status, considering user permissions and configuration.

methods.name: getMessengerTypeOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML select element or displays current messenger type, depending on the view mode.
